title: feedback harvest tags a moat test after its release is cut, which breaks the closures manifest
detail: 0.244.0: resolve + verify + harvest of fb-a5ef442478e8 ran after v0.244.0 was released. harvest tagged the test, test_closures_map then failed (the manifest lacks the id), and scripts/regen_closures.py correctly refuses because __version__ is already released. Harvest should apply the same guard as regen and fail closed: refuse when __version__ is already released and say 'bump to the next version first, or harvest before the release'. Better still, sprint-complete/release should harvest before the bump so the closure ships in the release that has the fix.
